hooks.name: Backend: security-change guard
hooks.description: Targets entra-backend (Spring Boot). Fires BEFORE any write tool. NOTE: PreToolUse matchers are tested against the TOOL NAME (not the file path), so this matches the write tools and the path filtering happens inside the prompt. Flags edits to security-critical files.

action.prompt:
A write tool (fs_write/str_replace/fs_append) is about to run. Inspect the target file PATH in the tool input. This guard only applies when the path is a backend security-critical file, specifically:
- entra-backend/src/main/java/com/example/entraoauth/security/SecurityConfig.java
- any file under entra-backend/src/main/java/com/example/entraoauth/security/ (JwtConfig, AudienceValidator, RolesClaimConverter, AccessAuditFilter)
- entra-backend/src/main/resources/application.yml

If the path is NOT one of these, do nothing and let the write proceed silently.

If it IS one of these, pause and treat this as a security-sensitive change. Before proceeding, clearly state to the user WHAT is changing and WHY it is risky, covering any impact to: authentication (issuer-uri / OIDC discovery), token validation (signature, issuer, expiry/clock-skew, audience via AudienceValidator), the roles-claim to ROLE_* mapping (RolesClaimConverter), CORS allowed origins/methods/headers, method-security (@PreAuthorize/hasRole) rules, and actuator exposure. Confirm the change does not weaken these protections (e.g. widening CORS to '*', disabling audience/issuer checks, permitting endpoints that should be authenticated). Recommend that DOC/SECURITY.md and the security property tests be updated to match. Then let the write proceed. Do not block the write; this is an advisory review.
